title: OpenAI's September annualized revenue nears $50 billion, less than previously indicated, source says
source_used: Reuters, read on the CNA wire copy (reuters.com returns 401)
key_facts: OpenAI told investors its annualized revenue for September was almost $50 billion, down from what it signaled earlier, a person familiar told Reuters on Thursday 8 Oct 2026.
It had previously indicated to investors at a separate event a run rate approaching $70 billion.
The discrepancy mainly arose from an attempt to produce a direct comparison with Anthropic, the person said.
OpenAI, unlike Anthropic, does not include revenue from sales via cloud partners such as AWS and Google Cloud.
Anthropic pays cloud partners about 16 per cent of every dollar earned through them, per a Reuters analysis.
The lower figure was first reported by the Financial Times.
Anthropic's quarterly revenue eclipsed OpenAI's in Q2: $11.5 billion against $6.7 billion.
Annualized revenue often multiplies one month's revenue by 12 and is considered sometimes misleading by analysts.
quote_evidence: OpenAI has told investors its annualized revenue for September was almost $50 billion, a drop from what it signaled earlier, a person familiar with the matter told Reuters on Thursday.
The discrepancy mainly arose from an attempt to produce a direct comparison with figures from rival Anthropic, the person said on condition of anonymity.
OpenAI, unlike Anthropic, does not include, for instance, revenue from sales via cloud partners such as Amazon's AWS and Alphabet's Google Cloud.
why_it_matters_hint: A $20 billion gap in a headline revenue figure matters as OpenAI and Anthropic prepare to go public.
notes: Reuters page blocked (401); read the Reuters wire story on CNA. Single anonymous source plus the Financial Times first report. The earlier ~$70 billion figure is described by Reuters as "Reuters and other media reported".
